_source: Trimmed snapshot of MUI (mui.com) Material UI v6, written by hand for benchmarking. MUI has no inventory CLI, so the mui adapter reads a file like this one; generate yours from your theme and component metadata.

spacing.scale: theme.spacing(n), or the sx shorthands p, px, py, m, gap

components.name: AppBar
components.description: Top application bar surface
components.accessibility: Renders a header landmark. Keep one per page.
components.usage: Wraps a Toolbar. position="sticky" keeps it available while scrolling.
components.avoid: Do not put more than one primary action row inside.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Horizontal row inside an AppBar, with the right height and gutters per breakpoint
components.accessibility: A layout row; the controls inside carry their own semantics.
components.usage: variant="dense" at small widths. Use the sx breakpoint object to change what is shown.
components.avoid: Do not hide overflowing controls with display:none alone; they stay in the tab order.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Icon-only action trigger
components.accessibility: Has no text, so aria-label is required. size="large" reaches a 48px target.
components.usage: Toolbar actions and overflow triggers.
components.avoid: size="small" is a 34px target: too small as the primary control on touch.

components.name: Button
components.description: Action trigger with a label
components.accessibility: Native button semantics with a visible focus ring.
components.usage: The action the user came for.
components.avoid: Do not style with literal colours; use the palette through color or sx.

components.name: Menu
components.description: Menu anchored to a trigger, with MenuItem children
components.accessibility: Focus moves into the list, arrow keys navigate, Escape closes and returns focus to the anchor.
components.usage: Overflow actions, including toolbar actions collapsed at small widths.
components.avoid: Not for form fields.

components.name: MenuItem
components.description: One action or option inside a Menu or Select
components.accessibility: role=menuitem inside a Menu, option inside a Select.
components.usage: Carries the same label as the control it replaces.
components.avoid: Do not nest controls inside an item.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Panel anchored to an edge
components.accessibility: The temporary variant traps focus and closes on Escape.
components.usage: Navigation and filter panels at small widths.
components.avoid: Not for confirmations; it is dismissed by clicking the backdrop.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal surface for a focused task or a confirmation
components.accessibility: Focus trapped while open. DialogTitle referenced by aria-labelledby is the accessible name.
components.usage: Confirmations get disableEscapeKeyDown and no backdrop close.
components.avoid: Do not let a destructive confirmation be dismissed by the backdrop.

components.name: Stack
components.description: One-dimensional layout with a gap from the spacing scale
components.accessibility: Layout only.
components.usage: direction accepts a breakpoint object: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' }.
components.avoid: Do not set margins on the children instead of spacing.

components.name: Box
components.description: Layout primitive with the sx prop
components.accessibility: Renders a div unless component says otherwise.
components.usage: sx values accept breakpoint objects: sx={{ display: { xs: 'none', md: 'flex' } }}.
components.avoid: Do not reach for it when Stack or Grid says what you mean.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Two-dimensional responsive layout
components.accessibility: Layout only.
components.usage: Column counts are given per breakpoint name.
components.avoid: Do not write pixel widths into a grid child.

components.name: Typography
components.description: Text with a variant from the type scale
components.accessibility: variant is visual; component sets the tag, so a visually small heading stays a heading.
components.usage: All text that is not inside another component's slot.
components.avoid: Do not set font sizes in px.

components.name: TextField
components.description: Label, input, helper text and error state in one field
components.accessibility: error plus helperText wires the message to the input through aria-describedby and marks it invalid.
components.usage: Any text field, including the ones that can fail validation.
components.avoid: Do not render your own error text next to the field; it is seen but not announced.

components.name: FormControlLabel
components.description: Binds a label to a Checkbox, Switch or Radio
components.accessibility: Clicking the label toggles the control.
components.usage: Every checkbox, switch and radio.
components.avoid: Do not place bare text next to a control.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Immediate on/off control
components.accessibility: role=switch. Wrap in FormControlLabel for its name.
components.usage: Settings that apply on change.
components.avoid: Not inside a form that needs submitting.

components.name: Alert
components.description: In-page message block
components.accessibility: severity="error" renders role=alert so the message is announced when it appears.
components.usage: Form-level and page-level messages.
components.avoid: Not for per-field validation; that is TextField's error state.

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Transient message at the edge of the screen
components.accessibility: Rendered in a live region.
components.usage: Confirmation after an action, with an undo where one exists.
components.avoid: Not for errors that need a decision.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Hover and focus hint
components.accessibility: Opens on focus. It is not a substitute for aria-label on an IconButton.
components.usage: Naming icon-only actions for sighted mouse users.
components.avoid: Unavailable on touch; never the only place the name lives.

components.name: Table
components.description: Table primitives: TableContainer, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableCell
components.accessibility: Real table semantics; TableCell scope carries the header relationship.
components.usage: Tabular data.
components.avoid: Do not rebuild rows from Boxes.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Compact marker for an attribute or an active filter
components.accessibility: A deletable chip needs an accessible name on its delete affordance.
components.usage: Active filters and statuses.
components.avoid: Colour alone does not carry the meaning.

patterns.name: ResponsiveAppBar
patterns.description: AppBar + Toolbar where the actions that do not fit collapse into a Menu below the md breakpoint, driven by an sx breakpoint object or useMediaQuery
patterns.usage: The documented way to make a toolbar work on small screens: the primary action stays in the bar, the rest move into a Menu behind an IconButton with an aria-label.
patterns.avoid: Do not hide the overflow actions with display:none alone; they remain reachable by keyboard and are then invisible.

patterns.name: FormField
patterns.description: TextField carrying its own label, helper text and error state
patterns.usage: Validation messages go in helperText with error set, so they are announced.
patterns.avoid: Do not pair a bare input with your own message element.

principles: Everything visual comes from the theme: palette, spacing, typography and shape. Responsive behaviour is written with the breakpoint names, through sx objects or useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('md')), never with literal media queries.
